about_the_game:
Enter the darkness. Fight for his soul.

In a world ravaged by the Emerald Plague, death is not the end... it’s only the beginning of corruption. In Tiris, you embody Liria, an alchemist and sorceress determined to defy death itself to save her beloved Narcis, turned into an abomination in the service of a dark Necromancer. Face hordes of infected, solve ancient puzzles, and unravel the cursed secrets of a disgraced cathedral.

Isometric Twin-Stick Shooter

Combine reflexes and strategy in a fast-paced, intense combat system with cover and shooting mechanics. Use alchemy, magic, and arcane weapons to face increasingly deadly enemies.

Explore, Solve, and Survive

Between battles, you'll face clearly designed yet profound puzzles that will test your wits in areas filled with traps, secrets, and hidden artifacts.

A dark, melancholic and stylized world

Discover a unique artistic universe: characters of heroic proportions with stylized textures, soft ambient lighting and decadent settings covered in fog and vegetation.

A story of love, death, and redemption

Immerse yourself in a tragic and heroic narrative: after the loss of Narcis, Liria embarks on an odyssey through the catacombs and cursed halls of a corrupted cathedral. Her mission: to gather the fragments of her beloved's soul and confront the monster they have turned him into. All while the corruption spreads and the Necromancer prepares his rise to immortality.

Player Objective in the Demo

Traverse three key areas of the Tiris Cathedral complex. Face the Necromancer and his hordes to win back your beloved. Can you restore his soul... or will you fall like so many others?

short_description: Infiltrate in Tiris Cathedral and recover your beloved's soul in this medieval, lowdark fantasy Top-Down Shooter. Deal with hordes of enemies, solve the puzzles that block your path, and free your loved one and the people from the tyranny of the Necromancer and his commanders.
